visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white button-up shirt, speaks directly to the camera in a living room setting with a tan sofa. She smiles and gestures with her hands, looking enthusiastic. (2) The scene cuts to her wrapping a white towel around her head; she is wearing a white robe-like outfit. She demonstrates how the towel stays in place without fasteners. (3) A side-by-side comparison shows two jars of water; a grey towel and a white towel are dipped into them to show absorption levels. (4) The woman is seen lying on a sofa with the towel on her head, then using her phone while sitting up. (5) A young man in a black tank top enters a kitchen/dining area and runs around while the woman attempts to wrap his head with a blue towel. (6) The woman hangs a large white towel over a balcony railing with a view of a city and green trees under bright daylight. (7) Back in the indoor setting, the woman holds the white towel and points to various on-screen text elements, continuing her explanation.
